answer_1.quote: The format of the KILT benchmark is model-agnostic, so any system capable of producing a textual output given a textual input is eligible to participate... tasks include open‑domain Question Answering (e.g., Natural Questions, ELI5) and Dialogue (Wizard of Wikipedia).
answer_1.outputs: textual answers, explanations, or dialogue utterances

answer_2.quote: We consider different metrics to capture the uniqueness of the different tasks in KILT... Accuracy for tasks that require a discrete output; Exact Match (EM) for extractive... ROUGE-L for ELI5 and F1-score for Wizard of Wikipedia... We also report retrieval metrics such as R‑precision, Recall@k.
